verdict.rationale: Capacities documents official synchronization across all devices, offline-first, with changes syncing once you're back online, so the core sync half of the story is delivered. The evidence never mentions end-to-end encryption or any guarantee that the vendor cannot read note content, and that is a central requirement of this story. Missing for 10: documented end-to-end encryption, evidence of zero-knowledge (vendor can't read) data handling, and independent or hands-on corroboration of sync reliability.
